name: [CernoIA PROD] WF-002 - Historial de cambios y versiones SECOP II

parameters.query:
SELECT
    source_code,
    cursor_timestamp,
    cursor_process_id,
    status,
    metadata
FROM ops.sync_cursors
WHERE source_code =
    'SECOP_II_PROCESS_VERSIONS';

WITH cursor_data AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(
            cursor_timestamp,
            '1970-01-01 00:00:00+00'::TIMESTAMPTZ
        ) AS cursor_timestamp,

        COALESCE(
            cursor_process_id,
            ''
        ) AS cursor_version_id

    FROM ops.sync_cursors

    WHERE source_code =
        'SECOP_II_PROCESS_VERSIONS'
)

SELECT
    version.id AS version_id,
    version.process_id,
    version.secop_process_id,
    version.version_number,
    version.change_type,

    version.previous_hash,
    version.new_hash,
    version.changed_fields,

    version.source_updated_at,
    version.captured_at,

    version.snapshot AS current_snapshot,
    previous_version.snapshot AS previous_snapshot,

    process.reference,
    process.entity_name,
    process.entity_nit,
    process.department,
    process.city,

    process.process_name,
    process.description,

    process.procurement_method,
    process.contract_type,

    process.base_price,
    process.process_status,
    process.opening_status,
    process.awarded,
    process.total_awarded_value,

    process.publication_date,
    process.process_url

FROM secop.process_versions AS version

JOIN secop.processes AS process
    ON process.id = version.process_id

LEFT JOIN secop.process_versions AS previous_version
    ON previous_version.process_id = version.process_id
   AND previous_version.version_number =
       version.version_number - 1

CROSS JOIN cursor_data

WHERE version.change_type = 'updated'

  AND (
      version.captured_at >
          cursor_data.cursor_timestamp

      OR (
          version.captured_at =
              cursor_data.cursor_timestamp

          AND version.id::TEXT >
              cursor_data.cursor_version_id
      )
  )

ORDER BY
    version.captured_at ASC,
    version.id::TEXT ASC

LIMIT 500;

INSERT INTO secop.process_change_events (
    version_id,
    process_id,
    secop_process_id,
    version_number,

    event_type,
    relevance_level,

    changed_fields,
    change_summary,

    status,
    source_updated_at,

    metadata,

    detected_at,
    created_at,
    updated_at
)
VALUES (
    $1::UUID,

    $2::UUID,

    $3::TEXT,

    $4::BIGINT,

    $5::TEXT,

    $6::TEXT,

    $7::JSONB,

    $8::JSONB,

    $9::TEXT,

    $10::TIMESTAMPTZ,

    $11::JSONB,

    NOW(),
    NOW(),
    NOW()
)

ON CONFLICT (version_id)
DO UPDATE SET
    process_id = EXCLUDED.process_id,
    secop_process_id = EXCLUDED.secop_process_id,
    version_number = EXCLUDED.version_number,

    event_type = EXCLUDED.event_type,
    relevance_level = EXCLUDED.relevance_level,

    changed_fields = EXCLUDED.changed_fields,
    change_summary = EXCLUDED.change_summary,

    status = EXCLUDED.status,
    source_updated_at = EXCLUDED.source_updated_at,

    metadata = EXCLUDED.metadata,

    updated_at = NOW()

RETURNING
    id,
    version_id,
    process_id,
    secop_process_id,
    version_number,
    event_type,
    relevance_level,
    changed_fields,
    change_summary,
    status,
    source_updated_at,
    detected_at,
    metadata;

parameters.query:
WITH last_version AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        captured_at
    FROM secop.process_versions
    WHERE id =
        $1::UUID
),

cursor_updated AS (
    UPDATE ops.sync_cursors AS cursor
    SET
        -- Avanza usando la fecha exacta guardada en PostgreSQL.
        cursor_timestamp =
            last_version.captured_at,

        cursor_process_id =
            last_version.id::TEXT,

        -- La ejecución aún continúa.
        status = 'running',

        last_run_at = NOW(),

        records_processed =
            cursor.records_processed
            + $2::BIGINT,

        error_message = NULL,

        -- Renueva el bloqueo después de cada lote.
        lock_expires_at =
            NOW() + INTERVAL '30 minutes',

        metadata =
            COALESCE(cursor.metadata, '{}'::JSONB)
            || jsonb_build_object(
                'workflow_code',
                'WF-002',

                'last_batch_count',
                $3::BIGINT,

                'last_version_timestamp',
                last_version.captured_at,

                'last_version_id',
                last_version.id::TEXT,

                'current_execution_id',
                $4::TEXT,

                'current_execution_batches',
                COALESCE(
                    NULLIF(
                        cursor.metadata
                            ->> 'current_execution_batches',
                        ''
                    )::INTEGER,
                    0
                ) + 1,

                'current_execution_records',
                COALESCE(
                    NULLIF(
                        cursor.metadata
                            ->> 'current_execution_records',
                        ''
                    )::BIGINT,
                    0
                ) + $5::BIGINT,

                'lock_renewed_at',
                NOW()
            ),

        updated_at = NOW()

    FROM last_version

    WHERE cursor.source_code =
        'SECOP_II_PROCESS_VERSIONS'

      AND cursor.active_execution_id =
        $6::TEXT

    RETURNING
        cursor.source_code,
        cursor.cursor_timestamp,
        cursor.cursor_process_id,
        cursor.status,

        cursor.active_execution_id,
        cursor.lock_acquired_at,
        cursor.lock_expires_at,

        cursor.records_processed,
        cursor.metadata,
        cursor.updated_at
),

run_updated AS (
    UPDATE ops.workflow_runs AS run
    SET
        batches_processed =
            run.batches_processed + 1,

        records_read =
            run.records_read
            + $7::BIGINT,

        -- Cada versión procesada produce un evento.
        records_written =
            run.records_written
            + $8::BIGINT,

        cursor_end_timestamp =
            last_version.captured_at,

        cursor_end_process_id =
            last_version.id::TEXT,

        updated_at = NOW()

    FROM
        last_version,
        cursor_updated

    WHERE run.n8n_execution_id =
        $9::TEXT

      AND run.workflow_code = 'WF-002'

      AND run.status = 'running'

    RETURNING
        run.id,
        run.n8n_execution_id,
        run.status,
        run.batches_processed,
        run.records_read,
        run.records_written,
        run.cursor_end_timestamp,
        run.cursor_end_process_id,
        run.updated_at
)

SELECT
    cursor_updated.source_code,
    cursor_updated.cursor_timestamp,
    cursor_updated.cursor_process_id,
    cursor_updated.status,

    cursor_updated.active_execution_id,
    cursor_updated.lock_acquired_at,
    cursor_updated.lock_expires_at,

    cursor_updated.records_processed,
    cursor_updated.metadata,

    run_updated.id AS workflow_run_id,
    run_updated.n8n_execution_id,
    run_updated.batches_processed,
    run_updated.records_read,
    run_updated.records_written,
    run_updated.cursor_end_timestamp,
    run_updated.cursor_end_process_id

FROM cursor_updated

LEFT JOIN run_updated
    ON TRUE;

UPDATE ops.sync_cursors AS cursor
SET
    active_execution_id = $1::TEXT,

    lock_acquired_at = NOW(),
    lock_expires_at = NOW() + INTERVAL '30 minutes',

    status = 'running',
    last_run_at = NOW(),
    error_message = NULL,

    metadata =
        COALESCE(cursor.metadata, '{}'::JSONB)
        || jsonb_build_object(
            'workflow_code',
            'WF-002',

            'current_execution_id',
            $2::TEXT,

            'current_execution_batches',
            0,

            'current_execution_records',
            0,

            'current_execution_started_at',
            NOW()
        ),

    updated_at = NOW()

WHERE cursor.source_code =
    'SECOP_II_PROCESS_VERSIONS'

  AND (
      cursor.active_execution_id IS NULL
      OR cursor.lock_expires_at IS NULL
      OR cursor.lock_expires_at <= NOW()
      OR cursor.active_execution_id = $3::TEXT
  )

RETURNING
    cursor.source_code,
    cursor.cursor_timestamp,
    cursor.cursor_process_id,

    cursor.active_execution_id,
    cursor.lock_acquired_at,
    cursor.lock_expires_at,

    cursor.status,
    cursor.records_processed,
    cursor.metadata;

INSERT INTO ops.workflow_runs (
    workflow_code,
    source_code,
    n8n_execution_id,
    trigger_type,
    status,

    started_at,
    finished_at,

    completion_reason,

    metadata,

    created_at,
    updated_at
)
SELECT
    'WF-002',
    'SECOP_II_PROCESS_VERSIONS',
    $1::TEXT,
    $2::TEXT,
    'skipped',

    NOW(),
    NOW(),

    'concurrent_execution',

    jsonb_build_object(
        'reason',
        'Otra ejecución del WF-002 tiene un bloqueo vigente',

        'attempted_execution_id',
        $3::TEXT,

        'blocking_execution_id',
        cursor.active_execution_id,

        'lock_acquired_at',
        cursor.lock_acquired_at,

        'lock_expires_at',
        cursor.lock_expires_at,

        'registered_at',
        NOW()
    ),

    NOW(),
    NOW()

FROM ops.sync_cursors AS cursor

WHERE cursor.source_code =
    'SECOP_II_PROCESS_VERSIONS'

ON CONFLICT (n8n_execution_id)
DO UPDATE SET
    status = 'skipped',
    finished_at = NOW(),
    completion_reason = 'concurrent_execution',

    metadata =
        COALESCE(
            ops.workflow_runs.metadata,
            '{}'::JSONB
        )
        || EXCLUDED.metadata,

    updated_at = NOW()

RETURNING
    id,
    workflow_code,
    n8n_execution_id,
    trigger_type,
    status,
    started_at,
    finished_at,
    completion_reason,
    metadata;

WITH cursor_snapshot AS (
    SELECT
        cursor.cursor_timestamp,
        cursor.cursor_process_id,

        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(
                cursor.metadata
                    ->> 'current_execution_batches',
                ''
            )::INTEGER,
            0
        ) AS current_batches,

        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(
                cursor.metadata
                    ->> 'current_execution_records',
                ''
            )::BIGINT,
            0
        ) AS current_records

    FROM ops.sync_cursors AS cursor

    WHERE cursor.source_code =
        'SECOP_II_PROCESS_VERSIONS'

      AND cursor.active_execution_id =
        $1::TEXT
),

run_finished AS (
    UPDATE ops.workflow_runs AS run
    SET
        status = 'success',

        finished_at = NOW(),

        batches_processed =
            GREATEST(
                run.batches_processed,
                cursor_snapshot.current_batches
            ),

        records_read =
            GREATEST(
                run.records_read,
                cursor_snapshot.current_records
            ),

        records_written =
            GREATEST(
                run.records_written,
                cursor_snapshot.current_records
            ),

        cursor_end_timestamp =
            cursor_snapshot.cursor_timestamp,

        cursor_end_process_id =
            cursor_snapshot.cursor_process_id,

        completion_reason =
            $2::TEXT,

        error_node = NULL,
        error_message = NULL,
        error_details = '{}'::JSONB,

        metadata =
            COALESCE(
                run.metadata,
                '{}'::JSONB
            )
            || jsonb_build_object(
                'completion_reason',
                $3::TEXT,

                'finished_execution_id',
                $4::TEXT,

                'finished_at',
                NOW()
            ),

        updated_at = NOW()

    FROM cursor_snapshot

    WHERE run.n8n_execution_id =
        $5::TEXT

      AND run.workflow_code = 'WF-002'

    RETURNING
        run.id,
        run.n8n_execution_id,
        run.status,
        run.started_at,
        run.finished_at,

        run.batches_processed,
        run.records_read,
        run.records_written,

        run.cursor_start_timestamp,
        run.cursor_start_process_id,

        run.cursor_end_timestamp,
        run.cursor_end_process_id,

        run.completion_reason
),

cursor_released AS (
    UPDATE ops.sync_cursors AS cursor
    SET
        active_execution_id = NULL,
        lock_acquired_at = NULL,
        lock_expires_at = NULL,

        status = 'success',

        last_success_at = NOW(),

        error_message = NULL,

        metadata =
            (
                (
                    (
                        (
                            COALESCE(
                                cursor.metadata,
                                '{}'::JSONB
                            )
                            - 'current_execution_id'
                        )
                        - 'current_execution_batches'
                    )
                    - 'current_execution_records'
                )
                - 'current_execution_started_at'
            )
            || jsonb_build_object(
                'workflow_code',
                'WF-002',

                'last_completion_reason',
                $6::TEXT,

                'last_completed_execution_id',
                $7::TEXT,

                'last_completed_at',
                NOW(),

                'last_execution_batches',
                cursor_snapshot.current_batches,

                'last_execution_records',
                cursor_snapshot.current_records
            ),

        updated_at = NOW()

    FROM cursor_snapshot

    WHERE cursor.source_code =
        'SECOP_II_PROCESS_VERSIONS'

      AND cursor.active_execution_id =
        $8::TEXT

    RETURNING
        cursor.source_code,
        cursor.cursor_timestamp,
        cursor.cursor_process_id,

        cursor.status,

        cursor.active_execution_id,
        cursor.lock_acquired_at,
        cursor.lock_expires_at,

        cursor.last_success_at,
        cursor.records_processed,
        cursor.metadata,
        cursor.updated_at
)

SELECT
    cursor_released.source_code,
    cursor_released.cursor_timestamp,
    cursor_released.cursor_process_id,

    cursor_released.status,
    cursor_released.active_execution_id,
    cursor_released.lock_acquired_at,
    cursor_released.lock_expires_at,

    cursor_released.last_success_at,
    cursor_released.records_processed,
    cursor_released.metadata,

    run_finished.id AS workflow_run_id,
    run_finished.n8n_execution_id,

    run_finished.started_at,
    run_finished.finished_at,

    run_finished.batches_processed,
    run_finished.records_read,
    run_finished.records_written,

    run_finished.cursor_start_timestamp,
    run_finished.cursor_start_process_id,

    run_finished.cursor_end_timestamp,
    run_finished.cursor_end_process_id,

    run_finished.completion_reason

FROM cursor_released

LEFT JOIN run_finished
    ON TRUE;

INSERT INTO ops.workflow_runs (
    workflow_code,
    source_code,
    n8n_execution_id,
    trigger_type,
    status,
    started_at,

    cursor_start_timestamp,
    cursor_start_process_id,

    metadata,

    created_at,
    updated_at
)
VALUES (
    'WF-002',
    'SECOP_II_PROCESS_VERSIONS',
    $1::TEXT,
    $2::TEXT,
    'running',
    NOW(),

    NULLIF(
        $3::TEXT,
        ''
    )::TIMESTAMPTZ,

    NULLIF(
        $4::TEXT,
        ''
    ),

    jsonb_build_object(
        'workflow_name',
        'WF-002 - Historial de cambios y versiones SECOP II',

        'lock_acquired_at',
        NULLIF(
            $5::TEXT,
            ''
        )::TIMESTAMPTZ,

        'lock_expires_at',
        NULLIF(
            $6::TEXT,
            ''
        )::TIMESTAMPTZ,

        'purpose',
        'Procesar versiones y generar eventos de cambios'
    ),

    NOW(),
    NOW()
)

ON CONFLICT (n8n_execution_id)
DO UPDATE SET
    status = 'running',
    finished_at = NULL,
    completion_reason = NULL,
    error_node = NULL,
    error_message = NULL,
    updated_at = NOW()

RETURNING
    id,
    workflow_code,
    source_code,
    n8n_execution_id,
    trigger_type,
    status,
    started_at,
    cursor_start_timestamp,
    cursor_start_process_id,
    metadata;
